overview.foundation: Cueson performs format-specific work at the file boundary. It exposes words, timing, speakers, provenance, layout, and other useful context while retaining the original file or subtitle graphics as authoritative evidence.
promises: Subtitle and caption content reaches one predictable structured surface.
The original carrier and its native details remain available.
Bitmap subtitle text can be derived through OCR without replacing the images.
Downstream tools no longer need a separate parser for every supported format.
in_scope: Text, XML, legacy binary, and bitmap subtitle formats
Cue timing, speakers, text, layout, provenance, and source envelopes
Derived plaintext from OCR and future transcription sources
out_of_scope: Replacing authoritative source files with normalized text
Claiming OCR output is lossless or authoritative
Activating cueson.io or changing the Cueson product repository in this slice
overview.sharp_edge: OCR and transcription are derived interpretations. Preserve the original visual or audio evidence and label confidence and provenance instead of presenting inferred text as ground truth.

voice.principle: Make the language inside media directly addressable without discarding its original carrier.
lead_with: the source format and retained evidence
avoid: claims that normalization replaces the source
personality: Names the source format, timing, and derivation method
Keeps the source and normalized view together
Language that implies the original is discarded
Format syntax presented as the user benefit
Labels OCR and transcription as derived output

logos.guidance: Cueframe places three unequal cue rails inside two open brackets. The brackets are the retained source envelope; the rails are directly readable structured caption content. The reduced master keeps the envelope and one rail for small sizes.
prohibitions: Do not close the two brackets into a caption badge or screen.
Do not equalize, reorder, or add cue rails in the full master.
Do not remove the source envelope from the full master.
Do not replace Cue Teal with inherited orange, success green, or failure red.
Do not add play, microphone, waveform, speech-bubble, or CC symbols.
Do not use the full master below 24 pixels. Use the reduced master at and below 32 pixels.
Do not combine the Cueson and ShruggieTech marks into one lockup.

instructions.title: Readme
instructions.markdown:
# Cueson application icons

Choose the platform directory below. Browser assets remain mirrored in `../favicons/` for compatibility.

| Path | Use |
|---|---|
| `web` | Browser, touch, and installable web |
| `android` | Android launcher and Play Store |
| `apple/ios` | iOS and iPadOS asset catalog |
| `apple/macos` | macOS catalog, iconset, and ICNS |
| `windows` | Win32 ICO and MSIX package assets |
| `domain` | Source-preserved product interface symbols, when supplied |

instructions.title: Readme
instructions.markdown:
# Android icons

Copy the `app/src/main/res` tree into an Android application and upload the separate Play image in Play Console.

| Path | Use |
|---|---|
| `app/src/main/res` | Launcher and adaptive resources |
| `play-store/google-play-512.png` | Google Play listing artwork |

instructions.title: Readme
instructions.markdown:
# iOS and iPadOS icons

Copy `Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset` into an Xcode asset catalog and select it as the primary app icon set.

| Path | Use |
|---|---|
| `Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset` | Current single-size default, dark, and tinted inputs |

instructions.title: Readme
instructions.markdown:
# macOS icons

Use the asset catalog in Xcode, the conventional iconset with `iconutil`, or the ready `AppIcon.icns` container.

| Path | Use |
|---|---|
| `Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset` | Xcode all-sizes catalog |
| `AppIcon.iconset` | Conventional iconset |
| `AppIcon.icns` | Application icon container |

instructions.title: Readme
instructions.markdown:
# Web icons

Browser, touch, and installable-web assets. `favicon.svg` is preferred; PNG and ICO files are fallbacks.

| Path | Use |
|---|---|
| `favicon.svg` | Preferred reduced-mark browser favicon |
| `favicon-full.svg` | Full-mark vector alternative |
| `favicon.ico` | Classic multi-size fallback |
| `apple-touch-icon.png` | Apple touch icon |
| `site.webmanifest` | Installable web metadata |

instructions.title: Readme
instructions.markdown:
# Windows icons

Use `classic/app.ico` for Win32 and the `msix` directory for packaged Windows applications.

| Path | Use |
|---|---|
| `classic/app.ico` | Classic application icon |
| `msix/Assets` | MSIX scale, target-size, and store assets |
| `msix/ApplicationVisualElements.fragment.xml` | Merge into Applications/Application |
| `msix/PackageProperties.fragment.xml` | Merge into Package for the Store logo |
